Sub-Agent Fanout: one task splits to four specialists. they work in parallel, then their results merge back at the lead. one clock drives the whole run. packets slide on that clock, and react only updates when someone lands, finishes, or merges.

Designer: @jeetnirnejak. Curated on Collect UI (https://collectui.com).
